title: Kuwait-flagged tanker KAZIMAH III hit in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: UKMTO reported a tanker struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, with the crew safe. Russia claimed drone strikes on cargo vessels in the Black Sea.
x_post: UKMTO reported the Kuwait-flagged tanker KAZIMAH III was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, crew safe. Russia claimed drone strikes on cargo vessels in the Black Sea. #MaritimeSecurity #Shipping #Seafarers #StraitOfHormuz
